title: docs(adr): ADR-0025 v2 — rewrite the four stale sections (registry → sys_package*, /cloud/packages, esbuild, L1 script bodies), fold the Q1–Q8 decisions in, split §3.5 steps 4–7 into dispatchable sub-steps, set the status line (M0 of #27108)
body:
Parent: #27108 (M0). Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed — ruling on ADR-0025 (objectstack#26553, 「插件包分发 同意，应该立专题卡吧？」). Filed by the director seat (`session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ No `domain:*`: `docs/adr/**` is Tier H; authoring is open to every seat and the director seat drafts this one unless triage routes it; the maintainer approves on GitHub.

## 维护者速读

把 ADR-0025 改成 v2：修正四处与代码不符的段落，把你 2026-10-28 同意的 Q1–Q8 决定写进记录，把 §3.5 第 4–7 步拆成可派发的小节，并改状态行。只改文字，一个 PR，你批准。M1–M3 的子卡在 v2 合并后按 v2 文本立。

## What changes

1. **§3.8 Versioning & lifecycle** — `sys_plugin` / `sys_plugin_version` / `sys_plugin_installation` are replaced by the fold the cloud already shipped: `sys_package_version` carries `artifact_kind`, `packaging`, `runtime`, `engines`, `permissions`, `integrity`, `sbom`, `signature`, `platform_signature`, `blob_key`; `sys_package_installation.granted_permissions`; `sys_package.visibility` / `marketplace_listed` (cloud `packages/service-tenant/src/objects/sys-package-*.object.ts`). Side-by-side versions and yank stay as pending items.
2. **§3.4 Build → sign → publish** — the publish target is `POST /cloud/packages` + `/cloud/packages/:id/versions` with `artifact_kind: 'plugin'` (`packages/cli/src/commands/plugin/publish.ts`), not `/cloud/plugins`; signing is Ed25519 over the raw artifact bytes with a `.sig` sidecar; counter-signing lives in cloud `package-review.ts`.
3. **§3.3 Packaging strategies** — the bundle is esbuild with `@objectstack/*` externalized (`build.ts`); **manifest-deps is dropped** (Q6; the build-side half is removed in M1 or this PR notes it as retired, enforce-or-remove ADR-0049).
4. **§3.10 three layers** — L1 is live today as hook / action script bodies under `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`; say so.
5. **§3.5 Install flow** — steps 4–7 become M1 (local, T0, self-signed) and M2 (cloud fetch, enforcement) sub-steps with their acceptance; `--trust-unsigned` named; T0 hard-limited to first-party / self-signed (⛔ line).
6. **§3.6 / §3.7** — tier dispatch and enforcement phased per Q3 / Q4; the "Landed as far as REGISTRATION" note stays until M2 deletes the pin.
7. **§7 Open questions** — widening UX answered by the shipped 409 re-consent; hot reload retired (#12587) → boot activation; key rotation, T2 RPC, dependency conflicts explicitly deferred to M3.
8. **Status line** — `Accepted — 2026-10-28 (ruled on objectstack#26553, ADR batch 4; proposed 2026-05-…)` narrowed to Phase 1 + consent, pending M1–M3 on #27108. Regenerate `docs/adr/README.md` with `node scripts/adr-index.mjs`.

## Acceptance

- `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` / `--self-test`, `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-links`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors` green.
- Every claim in v2 names a file that exists on `origin/main` (the inventory on #27108 is the source).
- No code change; `skip-changeset`.

**Size:** S (one record, ~8 sections). **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Related

#27108 (epic), #26553 (ruling), ADR-0025, ADR-0049, ADR-0016 §9.
